summary: Installed the three accepted PDFs and the reviewed canonical web edition of the Claude postconciliar Twenty-fifth Sunday in Ordinary Time, Year A, wired the publication, and ran every terminal gate check in this tree; all five exit 0. Nothing was committed. Before installing, `--phase artifacts --require-presentation` exited 0, so research/artifacts.json still described the built bytes, and all six accepted review seals (research under proper-study-v3, study, synthesis, homily, visual, web) were recomputed with scripts/_proper_study.py seal and each equals what its accepted result records. `make install-doc DOC=<id> PROVIDER=claude` was then run once per output with nothing suppressed: no -o, no -t, no touched timestamp, no dependency edit, and no change to an accepted source or to the generation timestamp. Make retypeset nothing - it found all three build PDFs current, ran the source check and the generation-metadata verification, and copied the bytes - so each installed and build PDF hashes to its accepted value: the 39-page study fd3a4d13f7bb980bbe3bb6025dac194997add5bf40a9f53eb4bced31af81dcb8 (330,921 bytes), the 12-page concise study 09275d9d8d97c81068c262dc7cab16f24744ce9f1b0f1af9bce8fd39e2cfa96f (216,677 bytes) and the 6-page homily 99a0877432a268bd56b92c4cfe45011d059a00ab42498113def2f376457bd70f (179,884 bytes). No hash differs, so no artifact defect is reported and no review boundary is reopened. The build-graph defect the previous production reported is fixed: the Makefile's derived-source glob now prunes evaluations/, so the standing-findings file written after the build did not make the derived PDFs stale, and the artifact check still exits 0 after installation. build/web/claude/<leaf>.md was copied byte for byte to web/claude/<leaf>.md (121,097 bytes, 2bd7f5908e264581a4e66b209dc825266d43b51c688d4887ddea77ff4cd3586d, cmp clean against the reviewed conversion and equal to research/web-artifact.json) and staged, so git ls-files --error-unmatch proves it tracked; only that one file was installed, not the provider-wide target, and no synthesis or homily web leaf exists. Three release records were created with `make add-publication ID=<output-id> CATALOG=library/novus-ordo-liturgy.md PROVIDER=claude STATUS=alpha`; none existed beforehand and none was overwritten, and each names schema 1, its exact output id, that catalog, status alpha and the standing authorization perpetual-public-repository-2026. In library/novus-ordo-liturgy.md only the Twenty-fifth Sunday row changed, and in it only the Year A cell: the Claude links were appended after the ChatGPT edition's in the manifest's output-label order (Research PDF, Synthesis PDF, Homily PDF, then the web page), labelled 'Claude Research PDF', 'Claude Synthesis PDF', 'Claude Homily PDF' and 'Read Claude' after the provider-qualified form the page's other shared cycle cells use. The ChatGPT links and labels, the B and C cells, every other row and every other cycle are untouched, and no companion row was added. One canonical marker was added, claude:<leaf>, prefixed because release/public-alpha.json names gpt primary. tools/tpt document-library structure regenerated the deterministic catalogue: the only change is this work's new Claude edition with its two companions, web page, contribution records and this run's produced identity; counts moved 195->196 documents, 221->224 issues, 6,258->6,297 pages, and the ChatGPT edition is unchanged. The release refresh was scoped to the three reader-facing paths this stage changed (ADOPT=1 ONLY=catalog, web edition, corpus.json), five changes, and check-release-bindings had named exactly those three beforehand, so nothing a sibling holds uncommitted was adopted. make check-publication-inventories had refused the tree: the Claude publication inventory listed neither this leaf, its source-bearing files nor the Week XXV owner's verified.md, and held superseded digests for three registry files this production's research checkpoint changed. tools/source-inventory refresh rewrote it from the current tree (53->54 publications, 1,248->1,285 files) and the new publication entered the classification review unresolved; its categories were set from the leaf's own 87 bindings and applied with tools/source-inventory classify: finding-aid, historical-primary, institutional-current, liturgical, patristic, repository-internal, scholastic, scripture, secondary. canon-law and magisterial are deliberately absent - the leaf uses no code of canon law and no conciliar, papal or doctrinal text, and the liturgical law it does use is printed in the Missal and recorded as liturgical. Gate checks run here, all exit 0: `--phase publication --require-presentation`; `make check-release-bindings` (0 stale); `tools/tpt public-alpha check --provider claude --document <leaf>` (scoped policy valid, 224 publications); `tools/tpt document-library check` plus `document-library structure --check`; and `make check-web-editions-current`. One upstream defect is reported rather than absorbed, and it blocks deployment but not this gate: `make check-sources` fails because tools/source-reader structure --check finds the tracked browser projection src/web/data/structure/sources drifted from the source records. Regenerating it into scratch shows thirteen differences, every one of them a source record this run's research checkpoint registered (IGMR 2011, Missale Romanum 2002, the 2010 ICEL Antiphonary, OLM 1981, Hilary in CSEL 22, Migne PL 24/26/37/92, the Venice Aquinas, USCCB daily readings and the 2026 calendar, and the index). That commit added seventeen such records without regenerating the projection. It belongs to the research owner and to shared browser data outside this leaf's publication wiring, so this stage repaired wiring only and left it; `tools/source-reader structure` plus a bindings refresh scoped to those projection paths is what clears it. Installation facts, the completed-review table from the run's own retained results, the classification reasoning and this defect are recorded in research/production-review.md.
